title: Bounded pre-search configurations
statement: For a Boolean-word input $x$ and a natural-number bound $B$, let $G(x,B)$ be the set of abstract configurations $a$ for which $a$ satisfies the precondition for the search program on input $x$ and every register value in $a$ is at most $B$.
